card.desc:
# There is a chance that the FSA (Food Safety Agency) shows up, if they show up they will ask to inspect your base. ([https://trello.com/c/X2l1QZQ5/698-food-safety-agency-inspector](https://trello.com/c/X2l1QZQ5/698-food-safety-agency-inspector "smartCard-inline") )

# If they inspect your base and see that you are growing Rokakaka, it will be seized.

# You can choose to either:

1. **Let them inspect the base**
2. **Ask for a warrant**

# Upon asking for a warrant they will call the [https://trello.com/c/gT0ygnyf/700-police](https://trello.com/c/gT0ygnyf/700-police "smartCard-inline")   and give you a search warrant.

# If you attack them during the inspection they will call the [https://trello.com/c/gT0ygnyf/700-police](https://trello.com/c/gT0ygnyf/700-police "smartCard-inline")   and [https://trello.com/c/xsO8UASY/701-swat](https://trello.com/c/xsO8UASY/701-swat "smartCard-inline")

# If you defend the raid you will be rewarded with:

**2500** [https://trello.com/c/Fsc3Vx1q/162-coins](https://trello.com/c/Fsc3Vx1q/162-coins "smartCard-inline")

**2** [https://trello.com/c/a8L1LKIu/143-arrow-part](https://trello.com/c/a8L1LKIu/143-arrow-part "smartCard-inline")

**1** [https://trello.com/c/b3xwPQ5j/152-mysterious-fertilizer](https://trello.com/c/b3xwPQ5j/152-mysterious-fertilizer "smartCard-inline")

**1 Random Seed**
